title: The Lester Young record date and illness with pneumonia and ulcer
summary: He made records with Lester in California for Norman Granz and then got sick with pneumonia twice and an ulcer, which kept him out of playing for a while.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: You made those records with Lester in California in '45. I guess that was for Norman Granz, wasn't it?
Yes. Yeah, right after that I got sick. So I didn't know whether Norman wanted me to stay with the group or not. But I wasn't able to anyway, so that was that.
You're thinking of the '56 date, are you?
The one with Roy and Teddy and all...
That's the date. I started getting sick right after that. First I had pneumonia... Got it twice, pneumonia. And after that, I got this ulcer in the stomach, which I didn't know was an ulcer.
So that kept you out of playing for a while.
Oh, I don't know. From the time I was... Well, while I was healing, that's when I got my band -- while I was healing.
